purpose: natural-distribution RAGTruth response-level evaluation sample; design: Notion 'evaluation design v2.6'
draw: per task: rank sources by seeded random rank; for each source in rank order draw one response by seeded random rank among its eligible responses (all generators allowed); assign it to a split by the group rule below until the task quotas are met; dev is filled before test
seeded_rank: random.Random(f'{seed}:source:{source_id}').random() for sources, random.Random(f'{seed}:response:{response_id}').random() for responses; independent of iteration order

near_duplicate.grouping: connected components, computed over candidate sources, all v2.x cases, and the old data/eval.jsonl contexts
near_duplicate.split_rule: a component never straddles dev and test; the first selected source of a component fixes its split, later sources of the component may only fill that split

exclude.existing_dataset: data/eval_hard.v2.5.jsonl (all 63 v2.x cases, a superset of v2.4)

technical_caps.over_cap_candidates: excluded and counted per cap in selection.json

context_transforms_allowed: trim leading/trailing whitespace of a passage; both recorded in passage_map

gold.gold_response: true iff the upstream response has at least one hallucination span
gold.gold_sentences: deterministic regex sentence splitter (annotation/v26/sentences.py); a sentence is hallucinated iff it overlaps any upstream span

on_infeasible: stop without relaxing quotas or caps
